mapper.select: INSERT INTO job.job_run ( runtime_namespace, job_key, job_definition_version, job_kind, input_json, status, schedule_key, scheduled_fire_time) VALUES (#{runtimeNamespace}, #{jobKey}, #{definitionVersion}, #{kind}, CAST(#{inputJson} AS jsonb), 'QUEUED', #{scheduleKey}, #{scheduledAt}) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO job.job_run_node ( run_id, node_key, node_kind, input_json, status, parallel_merge, max_attempts, retry_delay_millis, available_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{nodeKey}, #{kind}, CAST(#{inputJson} AS jsonb), #{status}, CASE WHEN #{parallelMerge} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{maxAttempts}, #{retryDelayMillis}, #{availableAt}) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO job.job_run_dependency (run_id, node_id, depends_on_node_id, dependency_order) VALUES
(#{runId}, #{nodeId}, #{dependencyId}, #{order})
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT n.id AS node_id, n.run_id, r.job_key, r.job_definition_version, r.job_kind, n.node_key, n.input_json::text AS input_json, n.attempt_count AS current_attempt, n.attempt_count + 1 AS next_attempt, n.max_attempts, n.retry_delay_millis FROM job.job_run_node n JOIN job.job_run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE r.runtime_namespace = #{runtimeNamespace} AND r.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND n.attempt_count < n.max_attempts AND ((n.status = 'READY' AND n.available_at <= #{now}) OR (n.status = 'RUNNING' AND n.lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY n.available_at, n.id LIMIT 1 ), node_started AS ( UPDATE job.job_run_node n SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = c.next_attempt, lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, started_at = COALESCE(n.started_at, #{now}), error_summary = NULL FROM candidate c WHERE n.id = c.node_id AND n.attempt_count = c.current_attempt AND ((n.status = 'READY' AND n.available_at <= #{now}) OR (n.status = 'RUNNING' AND n.lease_until < #{now})) RETURNING n.id AS node_id, n.run_id ), abandoned AS ( UPDATE job.job_run_attempt a SET status = 'ABANDONED', completed_at = #{now} FROM node_started started WHERE a.node_id = started.node_id AND a.status = 'RUNNING' ), attempt_started AS ( INSERT INTO job.job_run_attempt (node_id, attempt_number, worker_id, status, started_at) SELECT started.node_id, candidate.next_attempt, #{workerId}, 'RUNNING', #{now} FROM node_started started JOIN candidate ON candidate.node_id = started.node_id ), run_started AS ( UPDATE job.job_run r SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = COALESCE(r.started_at, #{now}) FROM node_started started WHERE r.id = started.run_id AND r.status = 'QUEUED' ) SELECT candidate.node_id, candidate.run_id, candidate.job_key, candidate.job_definition_version, candidate.job_kind, candidate.node_key, candidate.input_json, candidate.next_attempt AS attempt, candidate.max_attempts, candidate.retry_delay_millis FROM candidate JOIN node_started ON node_started.node_id = candidate.node_id
mapper.update: UPDATE job.job_run_node SET lease_until = #{leaseUntil} WHERE id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId}
mapper.select: SELECT source.output_json::text FROM job.job_run_dependency dependency JOIN job.job_run_node source ON source.id = dependency.depends_on_node_id WHERE dependency.node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY dependency.dependency_order
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job.job_run_dependency WHERE depends_on_node_id = #{nodeId})
mapper.update:
WITH node_updated AS ( UPDATE job.job_run_node
status = #{nodeStatus.value}, output_json = CAST(#{outputJson.value} AS jsonb), output_json = NULL, error_summary = #{error.value}, error_summary = NULL, available_at = #{availableAt.value}, completed_at = #{nodeCompletedAt.value}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL
WHERE id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId} AND attempt_count = #{attempt} RETURNING id ) UPDATE job.job_run_attempt
status = #{attemptStatus.value}, error_summary = #{error.value}, error_summary = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt.value},
WHERE node_id IN (SELECT id FROM node_updated) AND attempt_number = #{attempt} AND worker_id = #{workerId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE job.job_run_node target SET status = 'READY', available_at = #{availableAt}, input_json = CASE WHEN target.parallel_merge = 0 THEN ( SELECT source.output_json FROM job.job_run_dependency only_dependency JOIN job.job_run_node source ON source.id = only_dependency.depends_on_node_id WHERE only_dependency.node_id = target.id ORDER BY only_dependency.dependency_order LIMIT 1 ) END WHERE target.status = 'WAITING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job.job_run_dependency changed WHERE changed.node_id = target.id AND changed.depends_on_node_id = #{sourceNodeId}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM job.job_run_dependency dependency JOIN job.job_run_node source ON source.id = dependency.depends_on_node_id WHERE dependency.node_id = target.id AND source.status <> 'SUCCEEDED')

UPDATE job.job_run
status = #{status.value}, output_json = CAST(#{outputJson.value} AS jsonb), output_json = NULL, completed_at = #{completedAt.value},
WHERE id = #{runId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

WITH RECURSIVE exhausted AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT n.id, n.run_id FROM job.job_run_node n JOIN job.job_run r ON r.id = n.run_id WHERE r.runtime_namespace = #{runtimeNamespace} AND n.status = 'RUNNING' AND n.lease_until < #{now} AND n.attempt_count >= n.max_attempts ), failed AS ( UPDATE job.job_run_node n SET status = 'FAILED', error_summary = 'Job worker 租约到期且重试次数耗尽', completed_at = #{now}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL FROM exhausted e WHERE n.id = e.id AND n.status = 'RUNNING' AND n.lease_until < #{now} AND n.attempt_count >= n.max_attempts RETURNING n.id, n.run_id ), abandoned AS ( UPDATE job.job_run_attempt a SET status = 'ABANDONED', error_summary = 'Job worker 租约到期且重试次数耗尽', completed_at = #{now} FROM failed WHERE a.node_id = failed.id AND a.status = 'RUNNING' ), dependent AS ( SELECT node_id AS id FROM job.job_run_dependency WHERE depends_on_node_id IN (SELECT id FROM failed) UNION SELECT dependency.node_id FROM job.job_run_dependency dependency JOIN dependent ON dependency.depends_on_node_id = dependent.id ), cancelled AS ( UPDATE job.job_run_node SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = #{now} WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM dependent) AND status IN ('WAITING', 'READY') ) UPDATE job.job_run r SET status = 'FAILED', error_summary = 'Job worker 租约到期且重试次数耗尽', completed_at = #{now} WHERE r.id IN (SELECT run_id FROM failed) AND r.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
